Analysis

Era 1 of 8

1946 to 1959: Founding and early Cold War

Opened by: The UN starts work.

Palestine, Kashmir, Indonesia, Korea. 25% of resolutions concern admissions, elections or appointments. The USSR casts 89 of the 95 vetoes and 65 drafts fail for lack of votes. Palestine 1948 (54 (1948)) is the first "threat to the peace" finding, Korea 1950 (82 (1950)) the first "breach of the peace".

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • No subject rose by 5 points or more.

Vetoes

93 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 89, United Kingdom 2, France 3, China 1. 65 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
